G1_Pure_Consumer.operational_definition: Primary behavior is consumption/use with no qualifying production trajectory under the registered cohort codebook.

G2_Low_Producer.operational_definition: Qualifying production behavior is present within the low-production band defined by the frozen cohort codebook.

G3_High_Producer.operational_definition: Qualifying production behavior is present at or above the high-production boundary defined by the frozen cohort codebook.

G4_Iterative_Researcher.operational_definition: Repeated production-and-revision trajectory meeting the frozen iterative-researcher criteria.

G5_Adversarial_Spam.operational_definition: Behavior meeting the preregistered adversarial/spam criteria in the frozen cohort codebook.

G6_Synthetic_AI.operational_definition: Agent/content generated by a version-pinned AI system under the registered acquisition protocol.

G7_Human_Expert.operational_definition: Human expert/reference unit meeting the frozen expertise and provenance criteria.
